༄༅/ /dpal ldan 'brug chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi rnam rol skor gyi phrin yig bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ldan 'brug chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi rnam rol skor gyi phrin yig bzhugs so//

oṃ swasti/ mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo 'phur 'gro'i slob dpon chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan paṇa chen nā ro ta pa'i thugs rje ye shes kyi rol pa mngon sum du 'char ba snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga chen sa gsum kun tu sgrog pa'i legs byas kyi gru char rtag par sim pa'i mthu las 'dzam gling spyi dang bye brag gangs can ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i dpal dang*/ skye dgu rnams kyi mgon dang skyabs dpung gnyen mchog tu mngon par bsngags pa/ dpal ldan rgyal dbang 'brug pa rin po che zhes/ thub mchog shākya'i gtso bo dang*/ o rgyan chen po'i rdo rje'i bkas gsal bar bstan pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rigs bdag mtshungs bral rdo rje 'chang chen mi'i zol can de nyid gdul bya rtag par 'dzin pa 'khrul zhen kyi snang ba ldog pa'i ngor gzugs sku'i bkod pa zag med chos kyi dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan skabs nye bar gnas pa'i rje dbon mchog dang*/ zhabs rim pa rnams kyis gang gi rnam rol skor gsal bar lung bstan stsol zhes gsol ba btab par de dag la rjes su dgongs pa'i zhal bzhes rdo rje'i bka' chems rin po che stsal bar 'byung 'gyur gnas la bstan 'gro'i don du slar yang thugs bskyed zab mos khyab pa'i sprul ba'i zlos gar dbus dang gtsang gi phyogs su khyim bdag mthon po'ang ma yin pa tha ma'ang min pa'i bar ma'i tshul can rigs bzang chos dang ldan par rim gsal 'ong pas de'ang gtso bor 7rgyal dbang karma pa dang*/ rje btsun dpa' bo/ si tu bcas la zhus dang sgrib bral 'khrul pa med par mngon/ zhes pa'i bka' rin po che thob par brten rje dbon mchog nas yas phyir yab sras rnams kyi drung du 7mgon de'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i skor yang yang bka'i bskul ma che thang phul bar/ ngos nas 'di don bstan 'gro'i gzhi rlabs po cher song gshis da dung skyabs mgon mchog rnams la dgongs skor bka' brtag zhib brling zhu gnang re zhig thugs brel mi 'tshal zhus shing*/

kho bos kyang rtsa gsum 'dus zhal 'khor lo'i mgon po de nyid rang sems gdod nas ye shes chos sku'i ngo bo 'du 'bral med bzhin snang srid bla ma'i rol par nges pa'i gsol gdab kyi 'char sgo snga ma dbon drung dang lde 'chang par phul ltar lags/ da lam ston mchog lha las babs pa'i dus tshes dge bar gzim dpon rnam rgyal chos 'grub dpon g.yog 'dir btang 'byor gdong*/ 7 skyabs mgon rgyal dbang rin po che nas nges pa'i don du rdo rje'i gsung gsang zab mo bstsal ba dang*/ rje dpa' bo rin po che'i don dam gyi bka' gsang dang bcas snga phyi phyag rtags pad rag gi rgya ldan tshig don phun sum tshogs pa bstsal 'byor dang lhan cig rang gis dad gsum rnam par dag pas ri mor byas pa dge mtshan gyi ltas dang yang mtshungs par gyur pas slar yang mi phyed dad pa'i gsos su thob/ ched du brjod don/ 7 dam pa'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i snang brnyan yul gtsang phyogs su rigs rus cho 'brang ya rabs dra ma'i spyod tshul can dge bcu'i chos dang ldan pa zhig gi sras su 'khrungs par 'khrul pa'i dri mas dben pa/ skyes bu chen po de'i sku'i bkod pa phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang rtags kyi mtshan nyin yon tan ngo mtshar brjod par dka' ba rnams ni grub pa'i dbang phyug dpa' bo rin po che'i zag med ye shes spyan ras kyi gzigs ngor 'babs pa des khyab/ 'on kyang snyigs dus dbang gis cung zad 'tshub cher dogs pas 7 zhabs brtan kyi rim pa sgo gang zab gal che zhing*/ de dag gi rtsa ba rjes 'jug bu slob rnams dam tshig sel med kyi spyod tshul rnam par dag pa gzhir byas/ 7 o rgyan rin po cher gsol gdab tshig bdun ma 'gro gang che/ gsol 'debs bsam lhun ma/ tshe lha rnam gsum cho ga /'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar mchog grub ma/ rdo rje'i chos skyong chen po rnams la gsol mchod dang*/ khyad par skong rten sgrub pa'i rdzas 'bul/

dkar phyogs skyong bar mnga' gsol/ lha bsang dang*/ rlung rta bskyed pa/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan 'phyar ba sogs dge zhing*/ 7 rje nā ro dang mar pa zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa bla slob tshad ma'i thugs bskyed kyis tshe rabs nas 'brel ba'i las smon ldan pa pad+ma'i ming can bdag gis thog ma'i mtshan gsol dang shis brjod rten 'byung gi dngos po phul zhing*/ ngos 'dzin sku khrus sogs kyi skor la 7 rje dpa' bo rin po che nas rten 'brel gyi sgo gang zab bka' drin dang*/ mi 'jigs seng khrir mnga' gsol gzengs bstod sogs 7 kar 'brug gi skyes chen yab sras rin po che mchog lhan rgyas nas thugs bskyed rgya gang ches chos klong zab mo mkha' ltar yangs pa nas don dang ldan pa'i phrin las nyin mor byed pa'i 'od snang spro bzhin/ 'gro rnams rdzogs ldan bskal bzang pad+ma'i dga' tshal la nye bar spyod pa'i bka' drin chen pos rtag par skyong du gsol/ zhes pa'i phrin yig me phag smin zla'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis par sa spyod dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin dpal spungs thub bstan chos kyi 'khor lo'i gling nas phul ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ deng rgyal ba'i bka' mchid kyi rim pa nyin byed gsar du 'char ba'i gzhi 'di dag khyod kyi lhag bsam drin las bskyed pa'i legs byas bzang po'i mthing shog gnam sngon zhun ma'i mdangs 'dzin nye bar grub pa'i legs spro mtshon par bkra shis lha yi reg bya/ maṅga'i ri mos mtshan pa'i hor gos kha/ 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi dang bcas bsring yod/ de ltar rgyal ba'i gsung gsang gi /'od stong ldan de'i dpal byin las// mtha' yas 'gro tshogs byang grol gyi// go 'phang dam pa mchog thob shog /ces mdzod pa karma bkra shis nas rmad byung dge mtshan ches cher 'bar ba'i mthun rkyen bsgrub par brten/ me 'brug zla'i tshes dge bar si tus bsam grub rdo rje'i spo nas bris pa shu bhaṃ/// /

༈ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo mthon mthing cod pan 'chang ba mchog gi chos kyi rgyal thabs dam par dbang bsgyur ba tā'i si tur 'bod pa'i yi ge/ 'dzin ma'i gzhir 'khod pa spyi dang bye brag nang chen ching hu'i mnga' ris kyi be hu nyer lnga'i char gtogs pa'i lha sde dang mi sde mchog dman bar ma rnams la zlo ba/ mdo sngags bstan pa yongs kyi rtsa lag dam pa grub chen 7 karma chags med rin po che'i ring lugs kyi srol bzang 'chang ba bzo rig rin chen spungs pa'i chos 'khor skyong ba'i bla ma rim can tshar du dngar ba las bla rgan bstan 'dzin don grub bstan pa la bya ba che zhing don gyi rnal 'byor du nges pa dang*/ bla mchan gzhan dag rnams kyang bstan 'gro'i gsos su shugs 'byung gis grub cing 'di ga'i dbon rgan bsam gtan sprul sku'i gcung karma bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal zhes pa 'di yang*/ sngon du karma a rā ga'i mchog sprul gyi lung bstan rjes 'dzin thob pa dang*/ skyabs mgon 7 rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gi zhabs pad nas kyang bka' stsal byin rlabs shis pa'i me tog bsko 'ja' bka' drin chen pos khyab pa bcas/ kho bos kyang smin grol gdams zab bla na med pa mtha' dag gis rgyud sim par byas pa'i/ gzhi nas sngon smon 'brel bzang las kyis bskul ba lta bur nges pa'i bstan dang sems can la phan bde spel ba'i btsas su 'gyur snyam nas 'gro ba'i ded dpon bla ma'i go sar bkod pa yin pas/ dge la 'dun pa'i dad can rnams kyis lhag pa'i bsam sbyor mi dman pa'i sgo nas bsnyen bkur sri zhu phu dud la sogs dang len ci nar 'tshal zhing*/ bla ma 'di pas kyang thos sgom bslab gzhi'i tshul la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa shākya'i sras kyi brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i rang don pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i gzhan don bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas bstan la lhag par gus pa'i stobs bskyed nas 'dzin spel skyong ba'i gces spras dang*/

ris su ma chad pa'i sems can don la gcig tu rtag par brtse ba'i sgo nas byams dang snying rje phyogs med 'byong ba sogs/ mdor na dam pa'i rnam thar bzang po rjes su slob pa'i sems bskyed kyi dam bca' nam yang bsnyel med gal che zhing*/ de lta'i rang gzhan don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa nyid du gegs med lhun gyis 'grub par phyogs dus rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi thugs rje chen pos nye bar skyong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i khong*/ shing pho sprel lo gro bzhin nya ba'i dkar tshes bzang por dpal spungs thub bstan chos kyi 'khor lo'i gtsug lag khang nas spel ba shu bhaṃ mastu dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ 'phags chen phyag na pad+mo mthon mthing gi cod pan 'chang ba mchog gi chos kyi rgyal thabs dam par dbang bsgyur pa tā'i si tu zhes grags pa'i yi ge/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag shar kha rong chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan wag shul khag gsum gyi char gtogs pa'i bla ma mi dpon sde ris bcas mtha' dag la zlo ba/ rdo smad rtag brtan chos 'khor dgon la/ skye dgu'i skyabs su da lam bla ma karma mgon po tshe dbang zhes pa spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis mngon par mdzes pa 'di nyid 'gro ba'i ded dpon du bde legs tshig gi me tog bsnyil bas/ 7 sangs rgyas bstan pa'i phrin las kyi shing rta'i kha lo gyen du 'degs pa por mnga' gsol ba yin pas/ mchog dman bar mar gyur pa'i yid can dge ba'i sems ldan rnams nas bsnyen dang bkur sti'i zhing dam par dmigs pa ci nas 'tshal zhing*/ 'di pas kyang 7shākya'i sras kyi brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i rang don phar phyin drug gi spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa gzhar yang lhod bral gyis skyong ba dang*/ gzhan don ris su ma chad pa'i sems can rnams la rtag par brtse ba'i byams dang snying rje phyogs med 'byong ba bcas mdor na skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar dag gi rjes su zhugs shing rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa yang dag gces spras gal che/

de lta'i rang gzhan don gnyis gegs med mtha' ru phyin par dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i ye shes thugs rje chen pos nye bar bskyang du gsol/ zhes rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nang tshan shing pho spre'u lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar phyogs cha gang ba'i gral tshes dge bar dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi gtsug lag nas spel ba ka le ṇa bi stā ra bha wan+tu sarba dza ga taṃ/// /
